spans.s:
f. (-द्रिः)
The Śatadru river or Setlej; see शतद्रु.

f. (-द्रुः-द्रूः)
The Śatadru river.

m. (-तः)
1 A son.
2 A prince.
f. (-ता)
1 A daughter.
2 A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.)
E.
षु to bear or bring forth, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Born, engendered.
2 Sent, dispatched.
3

Drank.
4

Gone, departed.
m. (-तः)
1 A charioteer.
2 A carpenter.
3 A man of a mixed race, descended from a Kṣatriya father, and mother of the sacerdotal tribe; his occupation is managing horses and driving cars.
4 A bard, an encomiast.
5 The sun.
mn. (-तः-तं)
Quicksilver.
f. (-ता)
A woman lying in.
E.
षू to bring forth, क्त aff.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Well or entirely given.
E.
सु, and दत्त given, form irr.

m. (-मः)
The father of a son.
E.
सुत, गम to obtain, खच् aff.

mfn. (-नुः-नुः-न्वी-नु)
Very thin or delicate.
f. (-नुः or -न्वी)
A woman.
E.
सु excellent, तनु thin.

m. (-पाः)
1 A hermit, an ascetic.
2 The sun.
E.
सु very, profoundly, तपस् religious austerity, or तप to heat, असि Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
Hot, very hot.
E.
सु, and तप्त heated.

ind.
1 Better, more excellently.
2 Consequently, of course.
E.
सु good, and तराम् aff.

m. (-नः)
The Coïl or Indian cuckoo.
E.
सु much, तर्द्द to hurt, aff. युच्.

m. (-लः)
1 A division of the lower regions, the sixth in descent.
2 The basement or foundation of a large building (?)
E.
सु well, and तल deep, profound.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Having children.
m. (-वान)
1 A drinker of the Asclepias juice.
2 The father of a son.
E.
सुत, and मतुप् aff.

f. (-रा)
The mother of seven children.

f. (-णी)
A plant, (Salvinia cucullata.)
E.
सुत offspring, and श्रेणी a line.

m. (-हः)
Paternal affection.
E.
सुत, and स्नेह affection.

m. (-जः)
A grandson.
f. (-जा)
A grand-daughter.
E.
सुत a son, or सुता a daughter, and आत्मजा a daughter.

f. (-का)
A sort of tutelar goddess peculiar to the Jainas.

mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि)
Desirous of having a son.
E.
सुत, and अर्थिन् who seeks.

m. (-कः)
A kind of gentian, (Gentiana cherayta.)
2 The coral tree.
E.
सु very, तिक्त bitter, कन् added.

m. (-ती)
A father, one who has a son.
f. (-नी)
A mother, the mother of a son.
E.
सुत, and इनि aff., fem. form.

mfn. (-क्ष्णः-क्ष्णा-क्ष्णं)
1 Very sharp.
2 Very pungent.
3 Acutely painful.
m. (-क्ष्णः)
A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga.)
E.
सु exceedingly, and तीक्ष्ण sharp, &c.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं)
Very lofty or tall.
m. (-ङ्गः)
The cocoanut tree.
E.
सु very, तुङ्ग tall.

mfn. (-जाः-जाः-जः)
1 Very bright, splendid.
2 Potent.
m. (-जाः)
One of the Jinas of the last age.
E.
सु much, तेजस् light or glory.

f. (-त्तिः)
Birth of a son.
E.
सुत, and उत्पत्ति birth.

f. (-त्या)
Religious bathing.
E.
षु to bear, क्यप् aff., form irr., more usually सूत्या.

f. (-त्या)
Religious bathing, ablution, preparatory or subsequent to a sacrifice.
2 Drinking the juice of the acid Asclepias at a sacrifice.
E.
सू to bear, (fruit or offspring,) क्यप् aff., तुक् augment, and टाप् fem. aff.

m. (-मा)
INDRA.
E.
सु good, चा to preserve, (the world,) मनिन् aff.; also सूत्रामन्.

m. (-मा)
INDRA.
E.
सु well, चै to preserve, मनिन् aff., and the vowel of the prefix, optionally long; also सुत्रामन्.

m. (-त्वा)
A student who has performed his ablutions subsequent, or according to some, preparatory to a sacrifice.
2 A drinker of the Asclepias juice.
3 An offerer of the same.
E.
षु to bring forth, क्वनिप् aff., तुक् augment.

n. (-कं)
1 Birth, production.
2 Impurity from child-birth or miscarriage.
mn. (-कः-कं)
Quicksilver.
f. (-का-तिका)
A woman recently delivered.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-त्त्रः)
A name of KARṆA.
E.
सूत the sun, and पुत्त्र son; also सूतपुत्त्रक and similar compounds, as सूततनय, &c.

f. (-तिः)
1 Birth, production, delivery, parturition, bringing forth.
2 Offspring, progeny.
3 Sewing.
E.
षू to bring forth, as young, or सिव to sew, क्तिच् aff.; in the latter ऊ is substituted for the finals.

n. (-हं)
A part of a house appropriated to the women, or to a lying-in woman especially.
E.
सूतका or सूतिका a lying-in woman. and गृह house or room; hence also सूतकागृह n. (-हं).

n. (-नं)
The lying-in chamber: see the last.
E.
सूतिका a lying-in woman, and भवन a house.

n. (-हं)
The lying-in chamber: see सूतिकागृह.
E.
सूति delivery, child-birth, गृह a house.

n. (-हं)
The lying-in chamber.
E.
सूति delivery, and गृह a house, and the vowel made long: see सूतिकागृह.

m. (-सः)
The last month of pregnancy.
E.
सूति delivery, and मास month.

n. (-रं)
Snorting, roaring, any sound expressive of impatience or aversion.
E.
सूत् imitative sound, and कार making.

Superior.
2

Northern.
E.
सु very, उत्तर beyond.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Dexterous, clever.
E.
सु well, उत्थान exertion.

n. (-रं)
Distilling spirits.

n. (-चं)
Impurity from child-birth, continuing for ten days, or if in consequence of a miscarriage, for as many days as months had passed since conception.
E.
सूति child-bearing, अशौच impure.

r. 10th cl. (सूचयति)
To bind, to thread, to string.

m. (-त्रं)
1 A thread in general.
2 A rule, a precept, in morals or science; a short, obscure, and technical sentence, enjoining some observance in law or religion, or intimating some rule in grammar, logic, &c.; in each case it is the fundamental and primitive part of Hindu learning, and is the form in which the works of the early and supposed inspired writers appear; the ingenuity and labour of subsequent authors having expanded and explained the original Sūtras in various commentaries and glosses.
3 An opinion or decree in law.
4 A string, a collection of threads, as that worn by the three first classes, &c.
E.
षिव to sew, ष्ट्रन् Uṇādi aff., and इव changed to ऊ, or सूत्र to string, क aff.

Brahman.
2

A wagtail.
3 A dove, a pigeon.
E.
सूत्र a thread, and कण्ठ throat.

m. (-णः)
A small hour-glass-shaped drum, struck by a string and button fastened to it.
E.
सूत्र a string, and कोण corner; also with कन् added, सूत्रकोणक m. (-कः)

f. (-का)
A stick used in spinning the threads to be employed in weaving.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Who holds thread, &c.
E.
सूत्र, and ग्रह to take, अच् aff.

mfn. (-हः-ही-हं)
Who or what takes, but does not hold thread, &c.
E.
सूत्र, ग्रह to take, अण् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Arranging, putting in order.
2 Stringing.
E.
सूत्र used as a verb, ल्युट् aff.

f. (-टी)
A distaff, a spindle.
E.
सूत्र a thread, and तर्कुटी a spindle.

m. (-न्तुः)
A thread.
E.
सूत्र a thread, and तन्तु the same.

m. (-रः)
1 The principal actor or manager of a company, and chief interlocutor in the prologue or prelude to a drama.
2 A carpenter.
3 The author of a set of rules or axioms.
4 INDRA.
E.
सूत्र a rule, &c., and धार who holds.

m. (-ष्पः)
The cotton plant.
E.
सूत्र thread, and पुष्प a flower.

m. (-भिद् or -भित्)
A tailor.
E.
सूत्र thread, and भिद् who breaks or cuts.

m. (-भूः)
Incense.
E.
सूत्र thread, मध्य amidst, and भू born.

n. (-न्त्रं)
1 A shuttle.
2 A loom.
E.
सूत्र a thread, and यन्त्र a machine.

f. (-ला)
A spindle or distaff.
E.
सूत्र thread, ला to get, aff. अङ् and टाप्.

f. (-णा)
A sort of lute.
E.
सूत्र a thread, and वीणा a lute.

n. (-नं)
A weaver's shuttle.
E.
सूत्र thread, and वेष्टन surrounding.

f. (-ली)
A necklace or chain worn round the neck.
E.
सूत्र a thread, आली a line.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Arranged, methodised.
2 Ruled, directed in

Sūtras.
3

Strung.
E.
सूत्र used as a vest, क्त aff.

mfn. (-त्री-त्रिणी-त्रि)
Having threads, rules, &c.
m. (-त्री)
A crow.
E.
सूत्र a thread, इनि aff.
